name: Compiler Optimizer Engineer
description: Implement compiler optimizations: constant folding, dead code elimination, loop unrolling, register allocation, and SSA form.
example_snippet:
program ConstantFold:
    shape Instruction holds:
        Opcode as text
        Result as whole number
        Op1 as whole number
        Op2 as whole number
        IsConst1 as truth value
        IsConst2 as truth value
    end shape

    action fold takes Inst as ref Instruction produces truth value:
        if Inst.Opcode is equal to "add" then:
            if Inst.IsConst1 and Inst.IsConst2 then:
                put the sum of Inst.Op1 and Inst.Op2 into Inst.Result
                put true into Inst.IsConst1
                produce success with true
            end if
        end if
        produce success with false
    end action

    keep AddInst as Instruction with "add" and 0 and 5 and 3 and true and true
    keep Folded as truth value
    call fold with AddInst giving Folded
    print the text "Folded 5+3 = " and AddInst.Result and newline
end program
